meta.context: Operator-supplied PCU (Preconditioning Unit / cutter-compactor, EREMA pre-extruder stage) documentation page. Table gives bulk density of loose cut film ENTERING the compactor ('Bulkdichtheid invoer') and of compacted crumb LEAVING it ('PCU uitvoer bulkdichtheid'). Function chain verbatim: 'Snijden -> Frictie -> Verwarmen: vlokken krimpen en plakken lichtjes aan elkaar - samenpersen'. No bale densities in this document.

sim_conflicts.conflict: 320 matches neither state in the doc: loose cut film infeed is 25-180 kg/m3, PCU output crumb is 375-390 kg/m3. If FEED_DENSITY represents pre-compactor film use ~110-180; if it represents compactor output (cc_in) use ~375-390.
Confirmed for LD-Pe film 100 um (180 kg/m3). Thin LLD-Pe 35 um film would be 110, BO-PP 10 um would be 25.
No contradiction: document contains no bale densities. Bale density remains operator-calibrated estimate.
